name: binding-states-exact-with-refs-rejected
description: An exact-state slot binding carrying 'refs' (the set-family sibling) instead of the required 'ref' is refused as invalid_binding_shape: exact denotes exactly one code, never a collection.
notes: Mirrors binding-wrong-sibling-and-missing-member-rejected for the new state: the wrong-family sibling is present and the state's own required member ('ref') is simultaneously absent, and the specific category wins over schema_violation.
